description: M1.5 difficulty preset: veteran. Same as micro_breach_loss but applies `act.settings.set { ai_difficulty: veteran }` at boot so the guard is sharp (120hp, 6-tick aim_settle, 0.05 miss_chance, 480-unit sight, 600-unit hearing, 600-tick memory, 1200ms reload, 0.2 retreat hp pct). Player walks into LOS and stands still — the harder guard reliably scores enough hits to drop the player. Round-trip proved by observe.once.enemies[0] showing veteran values and mission.mission_resolved firing with loss_reason=player_dead.
